description: 1:50 000 Hydrogeological Survey Dataset for Poverty Alleviation in Xingguo and Ningdu Counties, South Jiangxi is a data set described in the paper "1:50 000 Hydrogeological Survey Dataset for Poverty Alleviation in Xingguo and Ningdu Counties, South Jiangxi" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2019), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). The new 1∶50 000 Hydrogeological Survey Dataset for Poverty Alleviation (also referred to as the Dataset) carried out in Xingguo County and Ningdu County, South Jiangxi is based on a water exploration project which aimed at alleviating poverty in southern Jiangxi under the unified deployment of the China Geological Survey, and the Ministry of Natural Resources of the People’s Republic of China. Coverage: Xingguo and Ningdu Counties, South Jiangxi, China, at 1:50,000. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support groundwater supply for poverty alleviation planning. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
